name: Pharosh
overview: Pharosh, also known as Parosh, is identified in Scripture as the ancestor of one of the families that returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity. The genealogical records in Ezra and Nehemiah highlight the significance of Pharosh’s descendants, numbering over two thousand, who were part of the restoration community. These passages emphasize the faithfulness of God’s people in preserving their lineage and heritage through the exile and return, underscoring the continuity of God’s covenant promises to Israel.
